title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 395 (Application of Act to government companies)

content.overview: The Central Government may, by notification, direct that any provision of the Act shall not apply to a government company, or shall apply with exceptions.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Central Government may, by notification, direct that any provision of the Act shall not apply to a government company, or shall apply with exceptions.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: A government company is defined in section 2(45). An exemption exists only if a notification in force says so. It is not implied.
